src/agent_runtime/core/collaboration_modes.py

Python · Tier A

Bind accepted collaboration intent independently of Agent Mode.

Responsibilities

Validate modes, remove untrusted context fields and suppress Plan compilation.

Boundaries

Neither user prose nor later composer changes can replace accepted task authority.

Lifecycle

Admission captures mode; resumption restores it from run state.

State

Only the supplied context is updated; there is no process-global mode.

Security

Strip client-supplied Plan artifacts before server-owned admission.

Collaborators

Native collaboration gates read the accepted mode via is_plan.

Public surface

validate, bind, is_plan and compiler_policy define the mode contract.

@see src/agent_runtime/native/collaboration_mode.py

src/agent_runtime/core/errors_msg.py

Python · Tier A

Own product diagnostic copy without making execution or recovery decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Provide stable message dictionaries and formatters shared by runtime, Gateway and UI error producers.

Boundaries

  • Text selection cannot classify effects, authorize retries, prove nonexecution or establish completion.

Lifecycle

  • Error producers select keys and supply diagnostic values; user_errors applies final presentation/redaction rules.

State

  • In-process constant dictionaries only; import adds message groups without opening files or contacting providers.

Security

  • Formatting does not sanitize arbitrary interpolated values; callers must apply the relevant public error boundary.

Collaborators

  • core/user_errors.py handles presentation; native completion and execution producers select established reason keys.

Public surface

  • USER_MESSAGES, MODEL_* and TEXT preserve copy keys; text and schema_violation interpolate producer values.

@see docs/architecture.md

@see src/agent_runtime/core/user_errors.py

src/agent_runtime/core/schema_containers.py

Python · Tier A

Traverse declared container types for argument decoding and structural validation.

Responsibilities

  • Share bounded schema traversal, local reference resolution and diagnostic paths.

Boundaries

  • Visitors own decoding or validation; composed schemas stay with the full validator.

Lifecycle

  • Each call walks supplied arguments and returns copies only for changed branches.

State

  • No persistence or shared mutable state; caller arguments and schemas stay untouched.

Security

  • No external schema I/O or branch guessing; public paths omit dynamic map keys.

Collaborators

  • schema_correction.py decodes containers; schema_validation.py checks their types.

Public surface

  • map_containers invokes a visitor at declared containers; container_path formats paths.

@see src/agent_runtime/native/schema_correction.py

@see src/agent_runtime/core/schema_validation.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
map_containers 72 Visit typed containers, copying only changed branches and preserving inputs. visit(value, types, path) may return a replacement container. Paths use actual keys/indices for validation; callers must redact dynamic map keys in public correction metadata. Strings permitted by a type union stay literal; supplied containers can still expose explicitly typed children. Unspecified properties/items and ambiguous schema branches stay opaque.

src/agent_runtime/core/user_errors.py

Python · Tier A

Preserve runtime error APIs while projecting canonical Error Catalog occurrences.

Responsibilities

Extract provider diagnostics and adapt historical unstructured failures.

Boundaries

Catalog owns human explanations; this facade changes no runtime decisions.

Lifecycle

Resolve once when an error crosses a user, trace or notification boundary.

State

No persistence; occurrence IDs travel in the existing error_detail payload.

Security

Mandatory catalog redaction applies even when optional general redaction is off.

Collaborators

Provider diagnostics supply safe model facts; error_catalog owns presentation.

Public surface

user_error_detail, user_error_message, user_error_preview and safe_error_text.

@see src/error_catalog/resolver.py

@see src/agent_runtime/native/outcomes.py
